description: Vox AC15C1 full-rig captures by OutmodedElectronics. This Crunch selection contains both Normal (Nrm) and Top Boost (TB) channels. V is Volume, T is Treble, B is Bass and C is Cut. Filenames retain the microphone identifiers for each capture, including blends. Input and output references are both 11.5 dBu. The amp, speaker and microphone are already included; no additional cabinet IR is required. Details are based on the supplied filenames and NAM metadata; an exact public pack page was not found.
